item.title: github: GitHub Desktop now supports multiple accounts per host
item.description:
GitHub Desktop now supports signing in with multiple accounts on the same host. This works for GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Server, and GHE.com.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
item.description:
GitHub Desktop 3.6.10+ now supports short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens for eligible accounts. This reduces the time a leaked token remains usable.

  • Source: GitHub
